capabilities.INTENDED: Claim or design intent exists. This is not executable proof.
capabilities.IMPLEMENTED: Executable implementation for the claim exists.
capabilities.OBSERVED: The behavior was directly observed in a running system or real HTTP/runtime path.
capabilities.DURABLE: The exact relevant state is durably versioned or persisted with an immutable identifier.
capabilities.DEPLOYED: The exact relevant state is present in the target runtime.
capabilities.VERIFIED: Independent or cross-layer verification corroborated the claim.

rule: Capabilities are not a total ordering. A claim may require several capabilities simultaneously.
